data.name: Hasan
data.gender_notes: Hasan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'to be good, beautiful'. Ḥasan means 'handsome, good, beautiful'. Its root is ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n). Borne by Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, grandson of the Prophet ﷺ. Hasan is a Arabic name meaning “Handsome; good; beautiful”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hasan expresses “Handsome; good; beautiful”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'to be good, beautiful'. Ḥasan means 'handsome, good, beautiful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasan total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
